name: Elder Morningdew
summary: During the Lunar Festival, Elder Morningdew greets travelers in Thousand Needles. She offers ancestral wisdom and blessings to those who honor her.

sections.title: An Honored Spirit of the Festival
sections.body: In Thousand Needles, Elder Morningdew greets pilgrims during the Lunar Festival as an honored ancestor. Across Kalimdor and the Eastern Kingdoms, revered spirits gather to celebrate wisdom, legacy, and peace. She belongs to neither faction and takes no part in mortal conflicts. Travelers who seek her counsel and show respect receive her blessing and a Coin of Ancestry.

faq.answer: Elder Morningdew is a night elf ancestral spirit who greets travelers in Thousand Needles during the Lunar Festival.

faq.q: What is the purpose of seeking her out?
faq.answer: Travelers seek Elder Morningdew during the Lunar Festival to honor the ancestors. She gives them a Coin of Ancestry and a blessing of wisdom.

faq.q: Does she belong to the Alliance or Horde?
faq.answer: Elder Morningdew is neutral in mortal politics. Alliance and Horde travelers can approach her peacefully and pay their respects.

angles.text: As a kaldorei, honoring elders like Morningdew connects you with the spirits who came before your people.
As a tauren, honoring ancestral spirits shows your deep respect for the wisdom of those who came before.
